title: DNA extraction (silica-column kit)
summary: Bench-standard genomic / plasmid / amplicon DNA purification using a silica spin-column kit (Qiagen, Zymo, NEB Monarch).
hazardsMd: Wash buffers contain guanidine + ethanol. Mix only inside a fume hood when first reconstituting. Do not autoclave guanidine waste — produces cyanide.
contentUndergrad:
## How silica columns work
In high-chaotrope buffer, DNA binds tightly to silica. Wash strips away protein and salts. Low-salt elution releases DNA back into solution.

steps.title: Lyse the sample
steps.instructionMd: Add lysis buffer + Proteinase K to the sample (volumes per kit). Vortex briefly. Incubate at 56 °C / 10 min (or per kit) until clear.
steps.verificationMd: Sample is uniformly cloudy at start, clear or slightly straw-colored after incubation. No visible particulates.

steps.title: Bind to column
steps.instructionMd: Add binding buffer (or ethanol per kit). Mix by inversion. Transfer ≤ 700 μL onto the column. Spin 1 min at 12,000×g. Discard flow-through.
steps.verificationMd: Column passes sample cleanly; if it backs up, the column is overloaded — split into two and pool eluates later.

steps.title: Wash twice
steps.instructionMd: Add wash buffer (volumes per kit). Spin 1 min, discard flow-through. Repeat. After the second wash, spin DRY for 2 min to remove residual ethanol.
steps.safetyNotesMd: Residual ethanol inhibits downstream enzymes; the dry spin is non-optional.
steps.verificationMd: Column matrix looks dry, not glossy. No droplets visible at the column outlet.

steps.title: Elute
steps.instructionMd: Move column to a clean tube. Pipette 30-50 μL elution buffer (warmed to 37 °C if low yield) onto the column membrane. Wait 1 min. Spin 1 min at full speed.
steps.verificationMd: Elution drops collect at the bottom of the tube. Volume matches what you added.

steps.title: Quantify
steps.instructionMd: NanoDrop the eluate. Expect A260/A280 ≈ 1.8 for pure DNA. Yield depends on input (typical: 1-50 μg from 10 mg tissue).
steps.verificationMd: A260/A280 between 1.7-2.0. A260/A230 > 1.8. Concentration matches expectations for the input.
